title: JSON schema for the Power Pages configuration file

defaultLandingPage.description: The path of the default HTML page to load when opening the website. This path should be relative to the compiledPath.

compiledPath.description: The path of the compiled output directory relative to powerpages.config.json file

bundleFilePatterns.description: List of glob patterns (strings) identifying file patterns to be cleaned up from web-files before uploading to Power Pages.

includeSource.description: Whether to include source code when uploading files to Power Pages. Defaults to `false` if not specified.

framework.description: The web framework and output format used to build the site.

name.description: The framework used to build the site.

buildFormat.description: The Astro output format. `directory` produces route documents such as `about/index.html`, `file` produces route documents such as `about.html`, and `preserve` retains each source page shape (`about.astro` becomes `about.html`, while `about/index.astro` becomes `about/index.html`).

sourceExcludePatterns.description: List of glob patterns (strings) identifying source file patterns to be excluded when uploading the site to Power Pages. This is only applicable if `includeSource` is set to `true`.
